covenants.name: Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio
covenants.waiver_or_amendment_note: Amendment No. 1 on February 26, 2026 increased maximum from 4.25 to 5.00 through December 31, 2026 and to 4.75 through June 30, 2027
covenants.quote: At June 30, 2026, the Company was in compliance with such covenant and the ratio was 4.37 to 1.00.

covenants.name: Consolidated Interest Expense Ratio
covenants.quote: The Company must also comply with a minimum Consolidated Interest Expense Ratio of 3.00 to 1.00. At June 30, 2026, the Company was in compliance with such covenant and the ratio was 4.86 to 1.00.
